text.en: Planting a tree and waiting for its first leaf is a lesson in love.

Brahmmam is a short story by Prabanjan. It says that living with nature and making nature useful is true aesthetics, and that growing trees is one way of repaying nature's kindness. When a sapling grows into a tree, its first leaf, flower and fruit bring joy.
The story presents tree planting as devotion and gratitude to nature.
Terms: மரம் (tree), இயற்கை (nature), நன்றிக்கடன் (debt of gratitude) and சிறுகதை.
